newsitem.title: SPAIN: Spain's Rato says Sept CPI data "very positive".
newsitem.headline: Spain's Rato says Sept CPI data "very positive".

text.p: Spanish Economy Minister Rodrigo Rato said on Friday that the September consumer price index report was "very positive."
"The news on the price index was very positive. There was a new decline in the price index in September and, more importantly, core inflation is now beneath 3.5 percent," Rato told jounalists.
Spain said today consumer prices had risen 0.2 percent month-on-month in September for a 3.6 percent year-on-year rate. Core inflation was 3.4 percent year-on-year.
